verdict.rationale: Signifyd publishes a documented public REST API covering authentication, requests, and data retrieval. Documented endpoints include Checkout, Sale, Get Decision, Chargeback, Representment Outcome, and webhook creation, so a programmatic user can drive the core fraud-review workflow end to end. The probe confirms the API reference docs are publicly reachable, including in markdown form. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real API usage beyond vendor documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
